description: This file defines utility functions and React hooks for managing progressive batch processing tasks in a React application. It provides a non-React utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` to process items in batches asynchronously, and a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` that manages UI state related to progressive processing, such as progress percentage and cancellation.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing of items with progressive updates, using requestIdleCallback or fallback to setTimeout.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps the controller to provide UI state management and control functions for progressive batch processing.
